summary.en: Brazil's Superior Electoral Court has announced the first-round results of the presidential election, with no candidate securing more than half the votes for an outright win. Incumbent President Lula and Flavio Bolsonaro, son of former president Jair Bolsonaro, will advance to a runoff. Flavio briefly led during the vote count with just over half the votes.

summary.zh_hant: 巴西高等選舉法院公布總統選舉首輪投票結果，沒有候選人取得過半數選票直接當選。現任總統盧拉與前總統博爾索納羅之子弗拉維奧，將進入第二輪投票。點票期間弗拉維奧一度暫時領先，得票略過半。

title.en: Brazil presidential race heads to runoff between Lula and Bolsonaro's son

summary.en: A Shanghai buyer purchased coriander worth 8.59 yuan online and was granted a 'refund-only' claim by the e-commerce platform after complaining the goods did not match the description. The seller, Mr Zhu from Xuzhou in Jiangsu, refused to accept losing both the money and the goods, and drove nearly 1,000 km round trip to Shanghai to retrieve the coriander in person, spending almost 1,000 yuan on fuel and tolls. The case has sparked heated online debate over abuse of the 'refund-only' mechanism, with many small sellers saying they have long suffered from malicious claims.
summary.zh_hans: 上海一名买家网购价值 8.59 元人民币的芫荽后，以货不对办为由获电商平台批准「仅退款」兼免退货。江苏徐州卖家朱先生不服钱货两空，决定自驾来回近 1,000 公里亲身到上海取回芫荽，单是油费连路费已花近千元。事件曝光后在网上引发两极讨论，不少网店卖家力挺朱先生，直指业界长年深受「恶意仅退款」所苦；亦有人认为卖家耗费大量时间金钱追货并不划算。
summary.zh_hant: 上海一名買家網購價值 8.59 元人民幣的芫荽後，以貨不對辦為由獲電商平台批准「僅退款」兼免退貨。江蘇徐州賣家朱先生不服錢貨兩空，決定自駕來回近 1,000 公里親身到上海取回芫荽，單是油費連路費已花近千元。事件曝光後在網上引發兩極討論，不少網店賣家力挺朱先生，直指業界長年深受「惡意僅退款」所苦；亦有人認為賣家耗費大量時間金錢追貨並不划算。

title.en: Seller drives 1,000 km to reclaim 8.6-yuan coriander after buyer's refund-only claim

summary.en: Following the Dubai airline cockpit attack, Israel's transport ministry has tightened restrictions on foreign aircrew, barring crew holding sole or dual nationality of 27 countries including Iran, Iraq, Oman and Saudi Arabia from operating or travelling on flights to Israel. Australian authorities are meanwhile investigating whether the co-pilot accused in the attack was radicalised locally.

summary.en: US President Donald Trump has announced the creation of a 'Super Intelligence' task force to coordinate the federal government's work on artificial intelligence. Trump signed an executive order last month renaming AI as 'super intelligence' (SI). Led by Director of National Intelligence Clayton, who also serves as the White House AI chief, the task force will coordinate interaction between the federal government, consumers, NGOs, critical infrastructure providers and businesses to keep the United States the global leader in AI, reporting directly to the president and the White House chief of staff.
summary.zh_hans: 美国总统特朗普宣布成立「超级智能」工作组，协调联邦政府各项有关人工智能的工作。特朗普上月底签署行政命令，将人工智能 AI 改称为超级智能 SI。工作组由国家情报总监兼白宫人工智能事务主管克莱顿领导，直接向总统及白宫办公室主任汇报，负责协调联邦政府与消费者、非政府组织、关键基础设施供应商及企业之间的互动，确保美国在人工智能领域继续保持全球领先地位。
summary.zh_hant: 美國總統特朗普宣布成立「超級智能」工作組，協調聯邦政府各項有關人工智能的工作。特朗普上月底簽署行政命令，將人工智能 AI 改稱為超級智能 SI。工作組由國家情報總監兼白宮人工智能事務主管克萊頓領導，直接向總統及白宮辦公室主任彙報，負責協調聯邦政府與消費者、非政府組織、關鍵基礎設施供應商及企業之間的互動，確保美國在人工智能領域繼續保持全球領先地位。

title.en: Trump launches 'Super Intelligence' task force to keep US ahead in AI

summary.en: As the National Day golden week reaches its midpoint, cross-regional travel and consumer activity across China are showing vitality and resilience. The report looks at tourism, transport and market performance during the holiday, capturing the energy of a China on the move.

summary.en: Under the influence of the northeast monsoon associated with a cold front, temperatures across most parts of Hong Kong were about two degrees lower this morning than yesterday. The Observatory forecasts temperatures between 25 and 31 degrees today, with urban lows falling to around 23 degrees tomorrow and Wednesday, a couple of degrees lower in the New Territories.

title.en: Cool northeasterly winds bring temperatures 2 degrees lower across Hong Kong

summary.en: The co-pilot accused of attacking the captain in a Dubai airline cockpit has reportedly admitted to investigators that he planned to seize control of the aircraft and crash it into Ben Gurion Airport in Tel Aviv. Israeli media reported that the suspect, Hamami, intended to wait until the plane entered Jordanian airspace before attacking the captain, and hoped to strike the terminal before Israeli forces could intercept. Investigators earlier said he appeared to have acted alone with no links to any militant group.
summary.zh_hans: 迪拜航空客机驾驶舱袭击案，据报涉嫌施袭的副机长哈马米向调查人员承认，原本计划操控飞机撞向以色列特拉维夫本古里安机场。以色列传媒报道，他打算等客机飞到约旦领空时袭击机长、取得飞机控制权，再在以军来不及拦截之前撞向客运大楼。调查人员早前表示，初步估计哈马米是单独行动，与任何激进组织没有关联。
summary.zh_hant: 迪拜航空客機駕駛艙襲擊案，據報涉嫌施襲嘅副機長哈馬米向調查人員承認，原本計劃操控飛機撞向以色列特拉維夫本古里安機場。以色列傳媒報道，佢打算等客機飛到約旦領空時襲擊機長、取得飛機控制權，再喺以軍趕唔切攔截之前撞向客運大樓。調查人員早前表示，初步估計哈馬米係單獨行動，同任何激進組織冇關聯。

title.en: Dubai airline cockpit attack: co-pilot allegedly planned to ram plane into Tel Aviv airport

summary.en: A shooting in Baltimore, Maryland's largest city, left a 12-year-old girl dead from a suspected stray bullet on Saturday afternoon. Police said two men exchanged gunfire near a park after a dispute over a parking space, and the girl and a woman nearby were hit. The woman sustained minor injuries, and no arrests have been made so far.
summary.zh_hans: 美国马里兰州最大城市巴尔的摩星期六下午发生枪击案，两名男子疑因争泊车位开枪，一名12岁女童怀疑中流弹身亡。警方说两人在公园附近口角后互相开枪，公园内一名女童和一名女子中流弹。女子伤势较轻没有生命危险，暂时未有人被捕。
summary.zh_hant: 美國馬里蘭州最大城市巴爾的摩星期六下午發生槍擊案，兩名男子疑因爭泊車位開槍，一名12歲女童懷疑中流彈身亡。警方話兩人喺公園附近口角後互相開槍，公園內一名女童同一名女子中流彈。女子傷勢較輕冇生命危險，暫時未有人被捕。

title.en: Baltimore shooting: 12-year-old girl killed by suspected stray bullet after parking dispute

summary.en: Police arrested the woman suspected of wielding a knife at Diamond Hill MTR station last night after firefighters forced open a flat door at Ching Wai House in Tsz Ching Estate, Tsz Wan Shan. Police said the station reported at 6:50pm that a woman carrying what appeared to be a ceramic knife struck the customer service counter before leaving. She was taken to Queen Elizabeth Hospital after her arrest.
summary.zh_hans: 钻石山港铁站傍晚怀疑女子持刀案，警员昨晚在慈云山慈正邨正晖楼一个单位，经消防破门入屋后拘捕涉案女子并送院。警方说昨晚6时50分接港铁钻石山站职员报案，指一名女子手持相信是陶瓷刀的利器，敲打客务中心柜台后离开。涉案女子被捕后送往伊利沙伯医院。
summary.zh_hant: 鑽石山港鐵站傍晚懷疑女子持刀案，警員昨晚喺慈雲山慈正邨正暉樓一個單位，經消防破門入屋後拘捕涉案女子並送院。警方話昨晚6時50分接港鐵鑽石山站職員報案，指一名女子手持相信係陶瓷刀嘅利器，敲打客務中心櫃枱後離開。涉案女子被捕後送往伊利沙伯醫院。

summary.en: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz visited Kyiv and met Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, announcing an additional €1 billion in German military aid to Ukraine. Merz said €350 million of the package will go toward repairing energy infrastructure, stressing Germany remains Ukraine's staunchest supporter for the sake of European security. The two sides also signed more than a dozen government and defence-industry agreements worth about €6.5 billion.
summary.zh_hans: 德国总理默茨到访基辅，同乌克兰总统泽连斯基会面，宣布德国将向乌克兰追加10亿欧元军事援助。默茨说追加援助当中有3亿5千万欧元会用于修复能源基建，强调德国一直是乌克兰最坚定的支持者。两国政府和军工企业之间亦签署十几份协议，价值大约65亿欧元，涵盖防空导弹、雷达设备和喷射无人机拦截器。
summary.zh_hant: 德國總理默茨到訪基輔，同烏克蘭總統澤連斯基會面，宣布德國將向烏克蘭追加10億歐元軍事援助。默茨話追加援助當中有3億5千萬歐元會用於修復能源基建，強調德國一直係烏克蘭最堅定嘅支持者。兩國政府同軍工企業之間亦簽署十幾份協議，價值大約65億歐元，涵蓋防空導彈、雷達設備同噴射無人機攔截器。

title.en: German Chancellor Merz visits Kyiv, pledges €1 billion in additional military aid to Ukraine

summary.en: Russia launched drone strikes on Kyiv and other parts of Ukraine overnight, killing at least one person and injuring six, Ukrainian officials said. President Zelenskyy said Russia fired 135 attack drones from Saturday night into Sunday morning, damaging infrastructure across multiple regions and causing power outages. Russia's defence ministry confirmed the strikes, describing them as retaliation for Ukrainian actions including attacks on civilian facilities.
summary.zh_hans: 乌克兰说首都基辅等地遭到俄罗斯无人机袭击，最少1死6伤。总统泽连斯基说星期六晚至星期日凌晨，俄军一共向乌克兰境内发射135架攻击型无人机，多个州基建受损、部分地区停电。俄罗斯国防部证实发动打击，说是回应乌克兰一系列行为，包括袭击俄罗斯民用设施、以图破坏国家杜马选举。
summary.zh_hant: 烏克蘭話首都基輔等地遭到俄羅斯無人機襲擊，最少1死6傷。總統澤連斯基話星期六晚至星期日凌晨，俄軍一共向烏克蘭境內發射135架攻擊型無人機，多個州基建受損、部分地區停電。俄羅斯國防部證實發動打擊，話係回應烏克蘭一系列行為，包括襲擊俄羅斯民用設施、以圖破壞國家杜馬選舉。

title.en: Russian drone strikes hit Kyiv and other Ukrainian cities, killing at least one and injuring six

title.en: HKU's new research chief champions early industry links to turn lab results into real-world impact
title.zh_hant: 港大新任副校岑浩璋倡產學研早期對接　推動創科成果轉化落地
title.zh_hans: 港大新任副校岑浩璋倡产学研早期对接　推动创科成果转化落地

summary.en: HKU's new vice-president (research) Charles Wang Sze-tsan says the university's "RISE" framework will connect research, innovation, strategic partnerships and entrepreneurship from the earliest stages of research, rather than only after results emerge. He wants universities to help scientists bridge funding, business-model and scaling hurdles so discoveries reach real-world use. HKU will host its InnoFest 2026 innovation festival from October 12 to 16, showcasing more than 120 research and innovation projects.
summary.zh_hant: 港大新任副校長（研究）岑浩璋表示，大學正透過「RISE」框架，整合研究、創新、策略協作及創業支援，嘗試將產學研合作由科研成果完成後嘅接洽，提前至研究初期，等產業需要同大學科研方向及早對接。佢話大學除咗推動前沿研究，亦要協助科研成果跨越資金、商業模式同技術規模化等關卡。港大將於10月12至16日舉行「港大創新節2026」，展示逾120項科研項目。
summary.zh_hans: 港大新任副校长（研究）岑浩璋表示，大学正透过「RISE」框架，整合研究、创新、策略协作及创业支援，尝试将产学研合作由科研成果完成后的接洽，提前至研究初期，让产业需要与大学科研方向及早对接。他说大学除了推动前沿研究，亦要协助科研成果跨越资金、商业模式及技术规模化等关卡。港大将于10月12至16日举行「港大创新节2026」，展示逾120项科研项目。
